variants: two reviewed branches that each add a new intent file and its SHA256SUMS line, so they conflict only in SHA256SUMS
landing_prep.py --apply with an approval that starts with APPROVE

expect.detail: both branches land in the keeper worktree, the SHA256SUMS union checks clean, the run and the brief say the file was auto-unioned and unreviewed, and the review marker is written last because it is the go signal

variants: a reviewed branch and its message file
landing_prep.py --apply with an approval text that does not start with APPROVE

expect.detail: the run refuses in one line and creates nothing: no keeper worktree, no keeper branch, no marker and no brief

variants: two reviewed branches that edit the same line of an ordinary source file
landing_prep.py --apply with an approval that starts with APPROVE

expect.detail: a conflict outside the few known intent files is never guessed at: the run stops naming the file, leaves the worktree for inspection and writes neither marker nor brief
